description: This file defines the Password class, representing the resource owner password credentials grant in an OAuth2 client library. It extends AbstractGrant and provides specific implementations for grant type name and required request parameters.

classes.name: Password
classes.description: Represents a resource owner password credentials grant, extending AbstractGrant, with methods to specify grant type name and required parameters.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the string 'password', identifying the grant type.

methods.name: getRequiredRequestParameters
methods.description: Returns an array with 'username' and 'password' as required parameters for this grant.
